Field.Label: Refreshes local Bonjour discovery and logs one row per physical device, including known offline devices. Status and Last seen reflect local communication. Last-seen dates are retained across restarts; devices never contacted locally show Never. This is not a scan of every LAN address. Disabled communications remain disabled.

Also includes devices registered to your Shelly account. Sign in directly with Shelly in the browser on the Indigo server Mac. Complete sign-in within five minutes; the plugin keeps codes/tokens only in memory for this report. Uses Shelly’s personal/experimental OAuth client.
Dimmers:
Field.Description: Create missing dimmable light output devices

Field.Label: Creates only the selected channel types for currently connected discovered devices. Existing devices and names are preserved. Devices marked no supported channels are discovered but cannot yet be created. Discovery continues without creating devices automatically.

Sets the local admin password used for this physical Shelly and all its channels. This does not change the password on the Shelly. Blank explicitly selects no password. Stored passwords are masked in this dialog and kept in Indigo preferences. A new discovered device never receives the shared password automatically.
